title: Data Engineer
summary: A data engineer builds the pipelines that move data from apps and systems into a warehouse where analysts and data scientists can use it. They sit in a data or platform team and own how data is loaded, transformed, scheduled and checked for quality.
dailyDuties: Build batch ETL or ELT pipelines in Python and SQL (jobs that extract, transform and load data)
Schedule and monitor pipelines in Airflow or a similar tool
Process large datasets with Spark or PySpark
Model and load data into Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift or Databricks
Add data quality checks and track lineage
Build streaming pipelines with Kafka or Kinesis
